decision.drift_note: OKHP3/skillz carries v1.2.0 (reviewed 2026-07-21) with full canon scope tables, per-denomination breakdowns, translation matrix, Pew demographic citations, and API routing detail. Local .agents/skills/ draft covers the high-level metadata fields only. Mirror and canonical are byte-identical; local source is not.
alternatives_considered: Overwrite skills/ mirror from local .agents/skills/ — rejected; local is the older draft.

limitations: Mirror equality proves current equality only; it does not reconstruct prior promotion authorization history.

recovery.path: Mirror at skills/okhp3-tradition-reference is read from canonical OKHP3/skillz. To restore: re-copy from abrahamic/okhp3-tradition-reference in skillz.
